verses.quotation: Give all your worries and cares to God, for he cares about you.
verses.note: Susan’s supplied approved NLT quotation.

verses.quotation: God is light; there is no darkness in him.

verses.quotation: God knows his plans for us—plans that offer hope and a future.

verses.quotation: Trust God wholeheartedly rather than relying only on your own understanding.

verses.quotation: God's word provides light and guidance for our path.

verses.quotation: Don't be afraid: God is with us and gives us strength.

verses.quotation: The Lord is our shepherd and provides what we need.

verses.quotation: Do what is right, love mercy and walk humbly with God.

verses.quotation: Jesus is the light of the world; following him leads to life.

verses.quotation: God loved the world so much that he gave his Son.

verses.quotation: Jesus declares himself to be the resurrection and the life.

verses.quotation: Jesus is not in the tomb—he has risen.

verses.quotation: Nothing can separate us from God's love.

verses.quotation: This day comes from the Lord; rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.quotation: Jesus tells his followers that they are the light of the world.

verses.quotation: Jesus is the way, the truth and the life.

verses.quotation: The Holy Spirit gives Jesus' followers power to be his witnesses.

verses.quotation: The Spirit produces love, joy, peace, patience, kindness and other good fruit.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Trusting God fills us with joy, peace and overflowing hope.

verses.quotation: We can praise God because we are wonderfully made.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Seek God's kingdom above everything else.

verses.quotation: Instead of worrying, pray about everything and experience God's peace.

verses.quotation: Find joy in the Lord and entrust your desires to him.

verses.quotation: Let your light shine so that others see the good you do and glorify God.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Be strong and courageous because God is with you wherever you go.

verses.quotation: Our help ultimately comes from the Lord, maker of heaven and earth.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Above everything else, put on love, which binds people together.

verses.quotation: Jesus Christ remains the same yesterday, today and forever.

verses.quotation: We are God's workmanship, created in Christ to do good works.

verses.quotation: The Lord is good; his love and faithfulness continue through generations.

verses.quotation: Jesus promises his presence when people gather in his name.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Rejoice in hope, be patient through trouble and continue praying.

verses.quotation: It is beautiful when God's people live together in unity.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Those who trust in the Lord receive renewed strength.

verses.quotation: Give thanks to God because he is good and his faithful love continues.

verses.quotation: Everything that is good ultimately comes as a gift from God.

verses.quotation: Allow Christ's peace to rule in your hearts and live thankfully.

verses.quotation: Come joyfully before God with worship and thanksgiving.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Love God wholeheartedly and love your neighbour as yourself.

verses.quotation: Jesus commands his followers to love one another as he has loved them.

verses.quotation: The Lord is our light and salvation, so we need not live in fear.

verses.quotation: When we are afraid, we can put our trust in God.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Thank God wholeheartedly and tell of the wonderful things he has done.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Love one another genuinely and take delight in honouring others.

verses.quotation: A child is given to us—the promised ruler whose names reveal who he is.
verses.note: Approved website paraphrase, not verbatim NLT. Set translation to NLT only after replacing this with approved verbatim NLT wording.

verses.quotation: Nothing is impossible with God.

verses.quotation: The angel announces wonderful news of great joy: the Saviour has been born.

verses.quotation: God's light shines in the darkness, and darkness cannot overcome it.
